perks.desc: Increases reload, range, and accuracy when no targets are in close proximity.

perks.name: Lone Wolf

perks.name: Headstone
perks.desc: Precision final blows spawn a [Stasis] Stasis crystal at the victim's location.

perks.name: High-Impact Reserves
perks.desc: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage.

perks.name: Focused Fury
perks.desc: Dealing a portion of the magazine as precision damage grants this weapon bonus damage. The shot count is reset whenever the weapon is reloaded or stowed.

perks.name: One for All
perks.desc: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Adrenaline Junkie
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon.

perks.name: Rampage
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage. Stacks 3x.

perks.name: Explosive Payload
perks.desc: Projectiles create an area-of-effect detonation on impact.

perks.name: Dark Ether Reaper
perks.desc:
Final blows with this weapon periodically spawn Dark Ether charges.

Charges can be detonated early with weapons fire or by coming into contact with them. Doing so refills this weapon from reserves.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 127 from 21 January 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/27QaoJnY0M7c7Ikhz8CbUv?si=397188c406294fcf) with @Saint_Kabr, @ImpetusAlways and @CourtProjects (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for Minor adds in general, and end-game underleveled content, particularly on Stasis builds. Red Tape is, surprisingly the first Lightweight frame stasis scout rifle - one of the stronger scout subfamilies for damage output in PvE, and offering the usual +20 Mobility and ×1.0625 boost to movement speed. At base, the stats are decent - the spread of stats among its peers is pretty compressed, though - 32 Range equates to 70.52m ADS and 35.27m hipfire, 33 Stability, 64 Handling is 0.36s ready, 0.30 ADS and 0.34 stow speed, and 52 Reload speed is a 1.96s reload. Look to boost Handling on M+KB, or improve control for controller with the barrel perk. In the mag, with the origin trait to bypass reload you could just go all-out for magazine size, or maybe look for additional reload speed for manual reloads in the mag perk slot. For Stasis builds, it's not the first scout rifle to offer the trait perk combination of Rimestealer, for Frost Armor stacks from breaking crystals generated by Headstone crit kills, but it's probably the best legendary that does. The Dark Ether Reaper origin trait is one of the best in the sandbox for PvE - generate a Dark Ether charge for 5s from kills, and then shoot (or run into) the charge to proc a Dragonfly-type detonation, which also overflows equipped and stowed Dark Ether weapons to ×1.4 (rounded up) base capacity or ×1.8 when enhanced, completely bypassing reload. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with a Backup Mag mod or, when masterworked, Synergy to create stasis shards or, when the artifact mod's around, Stunloader.

WarlockMaggie (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "(Prerelease notes) No bureaucracy here, Red Tape delivers a solid set of perks! Spec into Stability, Recoil mitigation and/or Reload for your Barrels and Magazines. And with stats handled, you can get grenade energy back with Demolitionist or get Frost Armor via Rimestealer, plus create crystals with Headstone or just do a chunk of damage with Focused Fury or Adrenaline Junkie!" Recommended MW: Stability or Reload Speed.

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): "Red Tape doesn't do anything exceptional but it does play into Stasis shenanigans if you use the crystals to gain a new sightline. You don't have to be near the Stasis crystal or enemy which means you can get Frost Armor from anywhere across the map. Keep Away and Lone Wolf also lean into this but don't give as many benefits. Explosive Payload would be great for fighting duals as the extra flinch is incredibly frustrating to fight against." Recommended MW: Stability.

pandapaxxy & WarlockMaggie (PvP / M+KB): "[pandapaxxy] Red Tape doesn't do anything exceptional but it does play into Stasis shenanigans if you use the crystals to gain a new sightline. You don't have to be near the Stasis crystal or enemy which means you can get Frost Armor from anywhere across the map. Keep Away and Lone Wolf also lean into this but don't give as many benefits. Explosive Payload would be great for fighting duals as the extra flinch is incredibly frustrating to fight against. [WarlockMaggie] I’m definitely going to be looking for a roll or few of this as it is our only non-Exotic Lightweight Stasis Scout. On par with the stats of Echoes’ Patron of Lost Causes, Red Tape does have better perks for PvP, including some unique combos like Closing Time + High-Impact Reserves. As with other longer range weapons, focus on Stability and Handling both in Masterwork, Magazine and/or Barrels." Recommended MW: Stability, Handling.
